newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso ends slightly ahead in anemic trade.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso ends slightly ahead in anemic trade.

text.p: The Mexican peso closed slightly ahead on a handful of dollar sales by local players Thursday, as the closure of U.S. markets dampened activity.
"No one was interested in doing anything, the market was really listless," said a trader.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart closed up 0.4 and 0.5 of a centavo, respectively, at 7.8850/7.8890 and 7.8690/7.8720 per dollar.
There was no trading in same-day contracts as U.S. financial markets were closed for the Thanksgiving holiday.
"Quotations varied by just a few centavos all day," another trader added.
Despite recent stability in the peso, dealers expect it to slide against the dollar in the first half of December as banks close their books for the year.
"The peso will be under pressure in the short term, as banks will be covering (dollar) positions to close their books before the first half of December is over," said a trader.
